description: 📌 CheckMyGuest presents this charming duplex situated in the heart of the 2nd arrondissement, just a stone’s throw from the Grands Boulevards, Rue Montorgueil and the Marais district. Sleeping up to 6 people, it offers a cosy base that’s ideally situated for exploring Paris on foot, with restaurants, cafés, shops and the capital’s iconic landmarks all within easy reach.The space⭐ Located on the ground floor of a Parisian building, this charming 45 m² duplex offers a comfortable, functional and welcoming setting in the heart of Paris’ 2nd arrondissement. Accommodating up to 6 guests, it is ideal for families or groups of friends, with a unique two-level layout and mezzanine.📍 Ideally located on Rue de Tracy, in a lively and central neighborhood, you will enjoy a prime location close to numerous restaurants, cafés, shops and public transport. The Grands Boulevards, Le Marais, Châtelet, Les Halles and many of Paris’ iconic attractions are all easily accessible on foot.⭐ A space designed for your comfort:✔️ A comfortable living room with sofa bed, TV and dining area with dining table.✔️ A fully equipped and functional kitchen: refrigerator, stovetop, oven, microwave, coffee machine, kettle, toaster and washing machine… everything you need to prepare your meals just like at home.✔️ A comfortable bedroom with a queen-size bed, TV and storage space.✔️ A shower room with shower and toilet.✔️ A second bedroom located on the mezzanine, accessible via a staircase, with two single beds.📍 Apartment highlights:📶 High-speed WiFi included.🧺 Bed linen and towels provided.🏡 Duplex with mezzanine offering a unique layout.📍 Central location in the 2nd arrondissement.✨ An ideal base for discovering ParisWhether you are visiting Paris to explore its iconic landmarks, discover the capital’s h
